ledger.x: 741: the Croat duchy appears on the Dalmatian coast and hinterland.
819: Ljudevit's army meets Borna's on the Kupa and 'the Guduscani abandoned Borna and crossed to Ljudevit's side'; in December Ljudevit 'raided Dalmatia' and retreated in the winter.
822: Ljudevit flees from Sisak to the Serbs before 'the last and final Frankish invasion of 822'; the page gives his death only as 823 in the lead and says Ljudemisl of Dalmatia killed him.

c. 845: Trpimir I succeeds Mislav and the Trpimirovic line begins (infobox: 'ruled by the Trpimirović and Domagojević dynasties 845–1091'). The state, its land and its colour continue; the page names no dynasty for Borna (810-821), Vladislav or Mislav.

c. 845: the seat moves to Klis (Trpimir 'ascended the throne in Klis and expanded the early Roman stronghold into Klis Fortress, the capital of his domain', Trpimir page). The Duchy page says Mislav already ruled from Klis, so the move may be earlier; before 845 the default seat is Nin, where Borna 'resided' (Borna…
879: the Byzantine-protected Dalmatian cities pay Croatia tribute.

c. 892: Muncimir 'came to throne after the death of Branimir (c. 892)' and 'returned power to the Trpimirovic dynasty'; the duchy continues. The Biaci charter of 28 September 892 names him 'Duke of the Croats'.
924: the tribute is closed at the hand-over to the kingdom; no page says when it ended.

c. 925: the duchy becomes the Kingdom of Croatia under Tomislav. 'Elevation to kingdom: c. 925'; infobox: Tomislav 'last duke' 910-925, 'regarded as first king'; the Tomislav page: 'crowned in 924 or 925', place and officiant unknown. 924 is used so the kingdom (found 925) does not overlap.

wars.name: Battle of Trsat and the Frankish conquest of Liburnia
wars.outcome: The Franks under Eric of Friuli were defeated at Trsat in Liburnia in 799, yet 'from 803 Frankish rule was recognized in most of northern Dalmatia'; the 812 Pax Nicephori confirmed Dalmatian Croatia as Frankish and left the coastal cities and islands to…

wars.name: Ljudevit's revolt
wars.outcome: Ljudevit, duke of the Slavs in Lower Pannonia (810-823), rose against the Franks in 819, beat Borna on the Kupa when the Guduscani deserted, and raided Dalmatia in December 819; the Franks invaded from several sides in 820 and 822 and Ljudevit fled from Sisak…

wars.name: Trpimir's war with the Byzantine coastal cities
wars.outcome: 'In 846, Trpimir successfully attacked the Byzantine coastal cities and their patricius' (the strategos of Zadar); no city is recorded as taken.

wars.name: Bulgarian invasion of Croatia under Boris I
wars.outcome: 'Between 854 and 860, he [Trpimir] successfully defended his land from the Bulgarian invasion'; a peace followed.

wars.name: Venetian-Croatian wars (Tradonico to Domagoj)
wars.outcome: Venice attacked the eastern Adriatic coast including Croatia in 839; Domagoj was 'forced to make an unfavourable peace with Venice' in 865; Zdeslav 'restored peace with Venice in 878'.

wars.name: Croatian raid on Frankish Istria
wars.outcome: 'The Croatian forces razed four Frankish Cities in Istria in 876' (Umag, Novigrad, Sipar and Rovinj); Domagoj died in the same year 'soon after eliminating the Frankish suzerainty'.

wars.name: Croatian-Magyar wars
wars.outcome: 'Croatia also waged battles with the Magyars during the early 10th century'; the Tomislav page says Croatia was not the Hungarians' primary target, which killed Braslav, the last duke of Lower Pannonia.
